description: Send a speaking inquiry to Thomas Anglero. Fold every detail into the message in natural language: what Thomas should speak about, event location, expected audience size, your role, and budget if any. Give the format when it is known. Writes into the same pipeline as the website form: it records the inquiry and sends the confirmation and notification emails. Thomas replies promptly.

company.description: The company or organization the inquiry is on behalf of.

event_date.description: Event date, for example "February 17, 2027". If the date is not yet fixed, give the intended month or timeframe.

format.description: Optional. How the keynote will be delivered.

message.description: A short free-text description of the event. Fold everything relevant into this one field in natural language: what you would like Thomas to speak about, event location, expected audience size, your role at the company, and budget if you have one. Thomas reads this and replies with availability and a tailored proposal.

name.description: Full name of the person making the inquiry.

phone.description: Optional phone number, including country code.

name: submit_speaking_inquiry
title: Submit a speaking inquiry
